headline: The Chuck E. Cheese animatronic band played its last show almost everywhere.
slides: Munch's Make Believe Band: Chuck E., Helen Henny, Mr. Munch, Jasper T. Jowls and Pasqually.
The company announced the bands would come out of its restaurants.
It was swapping them for screens, digital dance floors and trampolines.
One location, in Northridge, California, keeps the band, for nostalgia.
Reports say a second, in Nanuet, New York, kept it too.
Plenty of adults were sadder about it than the kids.
sources: Sources: NPR (2023), NBC, Chicago Tribune (2024), New York Times

the band you were scared of as a kid has retired
